title: Design System: ISCC — International Schools CS2 Championships

slogan.purpose: 百炼成徽 on the cover only, split by the cup.

display.purpose: One plate heading each, left-set, uppercase, two short lines.

cn-display.purpose: Chinese state of every heading, at 0.8em of the display.

cn-body.purpose: Chinese running text in Noto Sans SC.

label.purpose: Tracked caps at the 11px floor with tabular figures: buttons, readouts, captions.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: No drop shadows anywhere. Depth is rendered light, tonal stages and materials.

shadows.name: glass-edge-light
shadows.purpose: Edge light on smoke glass only; an edge of light, not a shadow.

shadows.name: inset-hairline
shadows.purpose: 1px boundary on fixed-ink tiles that sit on a matching ground.

materials.name: glass
materials.value: border-radius:14px; background:var(--glass); border:1px solid var(--glass-edge); backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(1.4)
materials.purpose: Smoke glass; variants reed (url(#reed) displacement + 7px rib overlay) and moss (url(#moss)).

materials.name: beams
materials.value: WebGL; blue from left, gold from right; pointer steers ±13°; click flash, 700ms cooldown; light arena multiplies, overlaps lift to a pale paper core

materials.name: smoke
materials.value: WebGL fbm volume, 3-step light march, up to 8 punched holes with healing rings
materials.purpose: Smoke plate; punched by 30-round tracer spray at 96ms per round, 1.4s reload.

materials.name: cup
materials.value: WebGL raymarched lathe; finishes polished, brushed, chrome, steel

materials.name: grain
materials.value: zero-mean hash grain in shaders (±.045 dark, ±.035 light) plus fixed fractal-noise overlay under content

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition none; static final frames

narrative.northStar: The Broadcast, Not the Style Guide
narrative.overview:
The championship is shown the way a viewer meets it: on air. Light, smoke, metal and a live observer HUD carry the argument, and the tokens, marks and overlays are what you lift off the frame afterwards. The page is ten plates, each sized to one viewport on desktop, each a single screenshot: cover, mark, light, smoke, metal, live, color, type, posters, footer. Prose is one line per plate. The specimens are the case.

Counter-Strike supplies the grammar and the school championship supplies the dignity. The two brand hues are the two sides: **CT is Legacy Blue, T is Cup Gold**, everywhere two things oppose (beams, scoreboard halves, player rails, stinger bands, poster rails, veto cells). Smoke is the glass material. A grenade lineup diagram and an authored spray pattern are the ornament. An authored fictional tactical map is the section navigator. The crosshair, four bars and a gap, is the construction of the mark: whatever the final logo is, it lives in the gap.

The system runs in two arenas (dark Arena Black, light Porcelain) and two tongues (EN, 中文), both persisted and applied before first paint. The five hues never change between arenas; only ground, ink, secondary ink and the text-safe gold swap. Everything is invented concept material and says so.
keyCharacteristics: Five hues at 70/20/10 (arena / depth / metal); CT blue and T gold as the two sides of every opposition.

Rendered materials, not CSS diagrams: WebGL god-ray beams, WebGL light-marched smoke, a raymarched cup in four finishes, reeded and moss glass through SVG displacement, zero-mean film grain under everything.
Square plates; glass alone is rounded (14px).
No drop shadows: depth is light, tone and material.
Headings left-set, never under a kicker; one centred line, the cover slogan, split by the cup.
One easing, `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`; reduced motion yields static final frames, never blank ones.
A logo slot instead of a logo: one CSS variable feeds every placement until the user's own mark arrives.

rules.name: The Two Sides Rule
rules.body: Where two things oppose, blue is CT and sits left or first; gold is T and sits right or second. Beams come blue from the left and gold from the right; rails, scoreboard halves and stinger bands follow. Side is never told by colour alone: position, monogram letter and tag text travel with it.

rules.name: The Five Hue Rule
rules.body: Only the five hues and their tints. CT Lit, the arena grounds and the hairlines are light and ground, not new hues. A sixth hue is a new identity.

rules.name: The No Red, No Green Rule
rules.body: The HUD never uses red or green. Loss is shown by emptiness: a dead player's bar empties and turns hollow, the name drops to secondary ink and stays legible, never dimmed by opacity.

rules.name: The Two Arenas Rule
rules.body: The theme switch swaps ground, plate, stage, ink, secondary ink, text-safe gold, hairlines and glass only. Artwork keeps fixed inks in both arenas: the arena-test tiles, the swatches, the posters, the 70/20/10 plate.

rules.name: The Tracked Caps Rule
rules.body: Micro-text is Archivo 600 at an 11px floor, uppercase, tracked 0.16–0.26em, in secondary ink or gold. The HUD scales its micro label but clamps it with `max(11px, …)`.

rules.name: The Fixed Digits Rule
rules.body: Digits that change sit in fixed-width boxes: tabular Archivo for readouts and hex, fixed `.56em` digit cells for Big Shoulders scores and clocks (the face has no tabular figures). Nothing moves when a number ticks.

rules.name: The Two Tongues Rule
rules.body: Every string exists in English and Chinese, swapped by one toggle with no layout shift; Chinese HUD labels sit in fixed-height nowrap boxes. The cover slogan, couplet and 金杯为证 stay Chinese in both states; "Earn your crest." stays English in both.

rules.name: The Flat Plate Rule
rules.body: A surface declares its boundary once: a 1px hairline, a tonal stage, or its own material light. Lift is motion (6px), never a shadow.

rules.name: The Light Behind Ink Rule
rules.body: Light sits behind reading text. Smoke may sit over artwork (the 金杯为证 specimen, the map, display type under the smoke plate), never over reading text; readouts that sit on rendered plates (round counter, cover foot, gap dimension) carry a solid stage ground.

dos: **Do** keep the 70/20/10 ratio: Arena Black field, Legacy Blue depth, Cup Gold at about 10%.
**Do** put CT blue on the left or first and T gold on the right or second, and back colour with position, monogram and tag.
**Do** show loss by emptiness: hollow bars, secondary ink, legible names.
**Do** keep light behind reading ink; smoke may cover artwork, never reading text.
**Do** set labels at an 11px floor in tracked Archivo caps with tabular figures.
**Do** run every motion on `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)` and give reduced motion a complete static frame.
**Do** route every logo placement through the slot (`--logo`, `.logo-slot`, `logo=`, the AE precomp).
**Do** label everything concept and invent every team, school, player, map and result.
donts: **Don't** add a sixth hue, red or green in the HUD, gradient text, or a drop shadow.
**Don't** place a kicker or eyebrow above a heading, or write "N things, one thing" headlines in either language.
**Don't** centre plate headings over equal grids; headings are left-set.
**Don't** use Valve or other third-party IP: no game logos, weapons, skins, agents or map art.
**Don't** set the mark or logotype in a font, or ship it with text, `font-family` or `currentColor`.
